consent.title: Apple Health Wearables Study
consent.intro: You are about to start the process of donating your Apple Health data to our study. The data that we ask you to donate will be used for academic research to gain insight into physical activity, sleep, and wellbeing behaviors. Only daily summaries are extracted: movement (steps, distance, energy, exercise, stand hours), heart rate, heart rate variability, respiration, blood oxygen and VO2max per day, nightly sleep, and your recorded workouts. Your date of birth, sex, blood type, body measurements, clinical records, ECGs, reproductive and sexual-activity data, workout GPS routes, and your device names are never read or transmitted.
consent.process: We will walk you through this process step by step. During this process no data is stored or sent to a server. You can filter by date, exclude workout types, and delete rows from the data before donating. Data will only be donated and stored when you click the button "Yes, donate" on the page that shows your data.
agreementPoints: you fully and voluntarily agree to donate your data for this research.
you are aware that when your data is used for academic publications, or made publicly available in some other form, this will be anonymous.
you are aware that you have the right to withdraw your permission.
consent.agreementCheckbox: I have read and agree with the above terms.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.intro: Please export your Apple Health data: on your iPhone open the Health app, tap your profile picture (top right), scroll down and tap "Export All Health Data", then "Export". Preparing the export can take a few minutes. When the share sheet appears, choose "Save to Files" (or AirDrop it to your computer). Upload the resulting export.zip here without unpacking it. If your computer unpacked it automatically, you can upload the export.xml file from the apple_health_export folder instead.
upload.processing: Processing your file... This may take a few moments for large exports.
upload.incorrectFile: The uploaded file might be incorrect, corrupted, or void of Apple Health data.
upload.possibleIssues: We were unable to find any recognizable Apple Health data in the uploaded file. This could mean:
issuePoints: The file is not an Apple Health export (export.zip or export.xml)
You uploaded export_cda.xml instead of export.xml
The export was interrupted or the file is incomplete
Your Health app has no activity, sleep, or workout data
upload.checkFile: Please check that you have uploaded the original export.zip (or the export.xml inside it) or contact the researchers for assistance.
upload.note: Note: The process to extract the correct data from the file is done on your own computer. No data is stored or sent yet. Extraction may take a while for large exports.

filter.intro: Determine whether you would like to donate the data below. Carefully check the data and adjust when required. You can filter by date range and exclude specific workout types. With your donation you contribute to the previously described research. Thank you in advance.
filter.donationPrompt: Do you want to donate the above data?
filter.note: Note: Sending the data may take several seconds depending on the data size.

thankyou.title: Thank You!
thankyou.successMessage: Your data has been successfully submitted. Thank you for your contribution!
thankyou.saveId: Please save this ID for your records.
thankyou.declineMessage: Thank you for your time. Your decision has been recorded and no data has been shared.
